SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  MIN(fished_date_doy) as earliest_doy,
  MAX(fished_date_doy) as latest_doy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fished_date_doy) as unique_fishing_days
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ts_hour,
  AVG(wtmp_c) as avg_water_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as readings
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2
  AND ts_doy >= 50
GROUP BY ts_doy, ts_hour
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC, ts_hour DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy,
  avail_hour
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 2
ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 20;
